verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a calendar and task-scheduling product, but the evidence never documents a user-driven way to select or act on many items at once. The closest material is adjacent and earns no credit: automatic rescheduling, Calendar Sync copying events, per-item priorities and hashtags, and a chat assistant that plans and optimizes the schedule. None of these is a documented bulk edit, delete, or update capability.
